lines.text: [tired, quiet] Night log. December fourth. One fifty A.M.
lines.asr: Night log December fourth one fifty AM

lines.text: [low, uneasy] The power's off. It's still turning.
lines.sub: THE POWER'S OFF. IT'S STILL TURNING.
lines.asr: The power's off. It's still turning.

lines.text: [whispering, terrified] They're closer. I never looked away.
lines.sub: THEY'RE CLOSER. I NEVER LOOKED AWAY.
lines.asr: They're closer. I never looked away.
